t: Buying an abandoned gold mine : r/Prospecting
s: May 23, 2024 - If it’s a sulfide ore then good luck, you’ll probably get nothing unless you have good equipment to mine it, mill it, and concentrate it, and someone else to process the concentrated sulfides into something usable. t: How to Buy a Mining Claim | Department of Land Transfer Information
s: Placer gold, is gold that has weathered from the host rock where it was formed, and been "placed" either on a hillside or stream bed. Placer claims are cheap and you usually get what you pay for. Not even large dredging companies last for long with placer gold. You cannot break minerals out of rock with a placer claim.
